case.summary: Case HHG-018 triggered a fraud review due to out-of-region card-present usage combined with historical risk indicators and mixed-channel activity, despite prior familiarity with the transaction amount and a regional dampener. Although the transaction was flagged by the model in decile 10 and shared device links suggested elevated risk, the customer directly confirmed making the purchase, resolving the ambiguity. Similar historical cases involving out-of-region use informed the initial risk assessment, but direct customer verification weighed heavily against the fraud hypothesis. Consequently, the calibrated probability of fraud dropped to 0.15, leading to a legitimate verdict. Per the policy engine actions, the case was created, the customer was verified, and a customer warning was issued.
